def get_release_month(song_title, artist_names):
    query = f"{song_title} {artist_names}"

    if search_results:
        for song in search_results:
            if song["title"].lower() == song_title.lower():
                release_date = song.get("release_date")
                if release_date:

                    return dt.strftime("%m/%Y")
    return None

# The release month/year for the first song is "03/2021".
# I will now write a function to get release month/year for a given song title and artists list using the same approach.
# Then I will iterate over all songs with missing release info and get their release month/year.
def get_release_month_year(song_title, artist_names):
    search_results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=song_title, page_index=0, page_limit=5)
    for song in search_results:
        # Check if any artist in the song matches the given artist names
        song_artist_names = [artist["name"] for artist in song.get("artists", [])]
        if any(artist in song_artist_names for artist in artist_names):
            # Extract release_date and convert to MM/YYYY
            release_date_str = song.get("release_date")
            if release_date_str:
                release_date = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date_str)
                return release_date.strftime("%m/%Y")
    return None

# Test the function on the first song

# Let's implement this for all songs in songs_to_update.

def get_release_month_year(song_title, artists):
    # Use the first artist's name for the query along with song title
    first_artist = artists.split(",")[0].strip()
    query = f"{song_title} {first_artist}"
    search_result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_index=0, page_limit=1)
    if not search_result:
        return None
    song = search_result[0]
    album_id = song.get("album_id")
    if not album_id:
        return None
    album_detail = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=album_id)
    if "release_date" in album_detail:
        release_date = album_detail["release_date"]  # e.g. "2019-01-01T00:00:00"
        # Extract month and year
        from datetime import datetime
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
        return dt.strftime("%m/%Y")
    return None

release_months = {}
for song_title, artists in songs_to_update:
    release_month = get_release_month_year(song_title, artists)
    release_months[song_title] = release_month

# I will collect the release month/year info for all songs to update the note content.
songs_to_update = [
    ("Silver Lining", "Ava Morgan"),

    ("Where Shadows Come to Life", "Olivia Roberts"),
    ("Eternal Melancholy", "Olivia Roberts"),

    ("Wading Through the Ashes of Love", "Marcus Lane"),

    ("Wilted Grace", "Felix Blackwood")
]

for song, artists in songs_to_update:

                # Extract month and year from release_date (format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM or YYYY)

                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    release_month_year = f"{parts[1]}/{parts[0]}"
                else:
                    release_month_year = f"01/{parts[0]}"  # default month 01 if missing
                release_info[song] = release_month_year
            else:
                release_info[song] = "TODO"
        else:
            release_info[song] = "TODO"
    else:
